initialBuild.title: Active/Afk Wizard (150+)
initialBuild.description:
## Savvy_Basics

Max accuracy stat first, then max idle casting. Priority is 10 > 12 > 5 >.  *1 excess points into Farsight, and *2 excess points into mana booster.

## Mage

Priority is 8 > 1 > 2 >. *1 excess points will be put equally into individual insight and knowledge is power. After that, *2 excess points will be put into mana overdrive. *3 excess points will be put into you're next and the rest into choppin it up ez

## Wizard

Max dmg skills, then max paperwork, great... After that, max mana is life. *1 excess points will be put into speedy book, *2 excess points will be put into Fuscia Flasks, and finally, *3 excess points will be put into staring statues.
